Speaker: 高勒趣
Content: Black Bear, White Boar, why are you fighting?
Chinese: 黑熊和白野猪，你们为何而争斗？
Note: 英文为团队游戏适配译文，非经文权威译文；保留队友原中文台词。

Speaker: 黑熊
Content: Human, with two eyes and such a great head, can you not see the trouble right before you?
Chinese: 人类，你长着两只眼睛，顶着这么大的脑袋，却连眼前的危机都看不到吗？

Speaker: 白野猪
Content: The north wind is howling. My herd needs food to survive the winter.
Chinese: 北风呼啸，我的族群需要食物过冬。

Speaker: 黑熊
Content: Look at the acorns on that tree. How happy my child would be to have just one!
Chinese: 瞧瞧这树上的橡实啊。要是能让我的孩子来上一颗，它该有多高兴啊！

Speaker: 白野猪
Content: Black Bear, your child needs food. Does mine not need it too?
Chinese: 黑熊。你的孩子需要食物，我的孩子难道不需要吗？

Speaker: 高勒趣
Content: Dear Bear and Boar, there are so many trees here. Why fight over just one?
Chinese: 这里的树这么多，亲爱的熊和野猪，你们何必为了其中的一棵争抢呢？

Speaker: 白野猪
Content: There are many trees, but this is the only one bearing fruit!
Chinese: 这里的树是很多，但能够结果的，可只有这一棵啊！

Speaker: 黑熊
Content: With something to fill our bellies, perhaps we could travel farther to find food.
Chinese: 要是能先用它果腹，我们就能去更远的地方找食物了吧。

Speaker: 高勒趣
Content: (Is there a way for everyone to share these acorns?)
Chinese: （有没有办法让大家都能分到一部分橡实呢？）

Speaker: 高勒趣
Content: (Perhaps there is a tool nearby that could bring the acorns down.)
Chinese: （这里说不定能有把橡实弄下来的工具。）

Speaker: 高勒趣
Content: (The axe has split the great acorn in two.)
Chinese: （用斧头把大橡实劈成两半了。）

Speaker: 高勒趣
Content: Will this be enough?
Chinese: 这点食物可够？

Speaker: 黑熊
Content: Enough to fill our bellies for now. Thank you so much!
Chinese: 足够垫垫肚子了，可太谢谢你了！

Speaker: 高勒趣
Content: Will this be enough?
Chinese: 这点食物可够？

Speaker: 白野猪
Content: Oh, yes! You are very kind!
Chinese: 啊，当然！你可真是个好心人！

Speaker: 白野猪
Content: Wait a moment.
Chinese: 请留步。

Speaker: 高勒趣
Content: What is it?
Chinese: 有什么事情呢？

Speaker: 白野猪
Content: What is your name?
Chinese: 你叫什么名字？

Speaker: 高勒趣
Content: Gaolequ.
Chinese: 高勒趣。

Speaker: 白野猪
Content: Gaolequ...
Chinese: 高勒趣……

Speaker: 高勒趣
Content: I am looking for my father, Egaole.
Chinese: 我正在寻找我的父亲俄高勒。

Speaker: 高勒趣
Content: I met... a fox. It told me that Shu had taken my father away.
Chinese: 我遇到了……一只狐狸，它告诉我，我的父亲被署神抓走了。

Speaker: 高勒趣
Content: Please, can you tell me what you know? How can I bring my father back?
Chinese: 您能告诉我您知道的事情吗？要怎么做才能让我的父亲回来？

Speaker: 白野猪
Content: Shu... I have not seen him for many years. I am sorry.
Chinese: 署神……我已经很多年没有去和他见面了，抱歉。

Speaker: 白野猪
Content: Take this Golden Grain. Shu gave it to us long ago. It is not for eating; it is sacred.
Chinese: 这份【金粮】给你。这是之前署神送给我们的。它不能吃，是很神圣的东西。

Speaker: 白野猪
Content: When you meet Shu, show him the Golden Grain. Perhaps it will soften his heart.
Chinese: 当你见到署神的时候，就把【金粮】给他看。说不定，他能够回心转意。

Speaker: 高勒趣
Content: Thank you so much.
Chinese: 太谢谢您了。

Speaker: 白野猪
Content: You helped us find food. We are the ones who should thank you.
Chinese: 你帮助我们拿到食物，我们才应该道谢才对。

Speaker: 白野猪
Content: Keep going. May your journey be safe!
Chinese: 继续前进吧，祝你一路顺风！
